title: My ten days plan
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y3 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: My ten days plan)
intro: Lesson 19: Good intentions at home and school, and the best ten days. To understand how good intentions turn everyday actions into worship, especially in the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah

questions.q: Make a good intention for doing homework.
questions.a: For example: to learn so I can help others and please Allah
questions.model: Teacher: 'Before homework I say in my heart: I am learning so I can help people and please Allah.'

questions.q: Which days are the best for good deeds?
questions.a: The first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah
options: The first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, fill in 'My ten days plan': three good deeds, each with the intention behind it. Start: 'I will ... so that ...'
questions.a: Three deeds with sincere intentions, for example: I will say takbir after salah so that I remember Allah
questions.model: Teacher writes deed 1: 'I will help clear the table every day so that I please Allah and help my family.'

questions.q: why does the intention matter even for small deeds?
questions.a: Allah rewards by intention, so small deeds with good intentions become worship

questions.q: Back to our ponder: why are the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah special?
questions.a: Good deeds in them are most loved by Allah
